meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让系统自动跑实验,持续优化代码与模型效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总在反复调参做实验,希望系统自动帮你找到更好的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run iterative experiments to keep improving your code and model results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of manually tweaking models and want the system to find the best approach for you

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把你定的目标和评分方式变成一轮轮实验:自动提出改进思路,在相互隔离的草稿区里试跑,记录有效与无效的教训;只有当某个改动在新一轮测试中依然更好时,才会把它定为最终结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“代码、训练方案、agent 框架”等可改动的产物,要求边做实验边评估并反复改进时触发;哪怕你没说“Arbor”,只要描述了反复实验—评估的循环,也会接管。

say.text: 帮我优化这个训练脚本,目标是降低验证损失,多做几轮实验。
say.note: 会先确认目标和评估方式,再开始搜索。

say.text: 提升这个 agent 在测试集上的通过率,别只盯着开发集调。
say.note: 强调 dev/test 分离,防止只记住开发集。

say.text: 比较几种数据处理方案,保留测试成绩最高的那个。
say.note: 会并行试多个方案,记录哪些有效或无效。

howto.what_en: Claude turns your goal and scoring method into a loop: it proposes improvements, tries them in isolated scratch areas, records what works and fails, and only makes something final if it still wins under a fresh test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to iterate on an artifact (code, recipe, agent framework, etc.) with a scoreable metric, or mention repeated experiment/evaluate loops, competing ideas, or a dev/test gap.

say_en.text: Optimize this training script to lower validation loss; run several experiments.
say_en.note: It confirms the objective and evaluator, then starts the search.

say_en.text: Improve this agent's pass rate on the test set, not just the dev set.
say_en.note: Keeps dev/test separate to avoid overfitting.

say_en.text: Compare data-processing options and keep the one with the highest test score.
say_en.note: Runs variants in parallel and logs lessons.
